gloss: in the soil; underground; in the earth

definitions.gloss: in the soil; underground; in the earth
definitions.explanation: Within or beneath the ground, referring to the interior of the earth or soil. Used in agricultural, archaeological, and scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{土中|どちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{埋|う}めた→埋める：01901_umeru⟧。
examples.english: I buried the seeds in the soil.

examples.japanese: {土中|どちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Moisture in the soil affects plant growth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発掘|はっくつ}→発掘：07995_hakkutsu⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{土中|どちゅう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遺物|いぶつ}→遺物：14545_ibutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: Ancient artifacts were found in the earth during an excavation survey.

notes:
A compound of {土|ど} (earth, soil) and ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (inside, within). Functions as a location noun and commonly appears with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to indicate location. Typical of the Sino-Japanese pattern where ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ indicates being inside something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土中|どちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{埋|う}める→埋める：01901_umeru⟧: to bury in the soil
- {土中|どちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧: soil moisture
- {土中|どちゅう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}する→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧: to discover from underground
- {土中|どちゅう}⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧: deep in the earth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地中|ちちゅう}→地中：12135_chichuu⟧: underground — emphasizes being beneath the ground surface, often used for larger-scale contexts like ⟦{地中海|ちちゅうかい}→地中海：20770_chichuukai⟧ (Mediterranean Sea)
- ⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧: underground — refers to the space beneath the surface, used for basements, subways, etc.
- ⟦{土壌|どじょう}→土壌：12040_dojou⟧: soil — the material itself rather than the location within it
